# Bundled dependencies

These files were extracted unchanged from the existing standalone app. The inherited documentation identifies Mermaid as v10; its precise release has not been independently established. The svg-pan-zoom header identifies v3.6.1. These hashes pin the actual file bytes used for assembly.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `mermaid.min.js` | `eda3a0ad572bbe69a318c1be0163e8233dd824f3f12939e5168feba207767151` |
| `svg-pan-zoom.min.js` | `fa0ddb794673ca573acfa61fe349856f7ad0e5d5b65a0b063d1397f55cd21064` |

Preserve upstream names, URLs, and embedded copyright/license notices. They identify third-party software, not the project owner. Before replacing these bundles, verify upstream release provenance and license requirements, then rebuild and run the regression suite.
